title: 大阪杯の後に・我等が示すは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki treat the exhilarated audience to an astonishing race, during which both runners help each other to overcome their limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Witnessing the race, Sakura Chiyono O vows to surpass her own limits and catch up to Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki announces that, should Sakura Chiyono O wish to enter the fray, her next race will be the Takarazuka Kinen, and that she fully intends to claim victory there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Overjoyed to have Yaeno Muteki as her rival, Mejiro Ardan sets her sights on the Takarazuka Kinen as well, sharing the promise.
